Notes: BUILD AND METER THIS BEFORE ANY PACK IS ON THE BENCH. The only lead that ever plugs into J1. Reversal defence is polarity discipline, not a fuse: a reversed pack drives ~20A through Q1-Q4 body diodes and kills the XIAO in ms, long before any fuse opens.
